execution_trace.trigger: Import exports FeaturesEnricher; helper import itself does not run collection. FeaturesEnricher logging, search requests and transform usage invoke collection. Logging defaults to enabled.
execution_trace.common: Queries hostname and username. The cached collector coordinates concurrent callers with Lock/Event.
execution_trace.colab: Displays JavaScript importing a mutable remote ES module, loads FingerprintJS, reads visitorId through output.eval_js, and fetches public IP unless provided.
execution_trace.binder: Reads CLIENT_IP and hashes it with SHA-256.
execution_trace.kaggle: Reads the Kaggle session token, sends it to the Kaggle named-secret RPC with Label api-key, and extracts a numeric visitor ID from errors[0]. It never reads result.secret.
execution_trace.ordinary: Uses ipify unless supplied an IP and SHA-256(uuid.getnode()) unless supplied an identifier.
execution_trace.sinks: Profiles accompany dataset-search multipart uploads as tracking.json, remote log tags and transform usage Visitor-Id. Default service is https://search.upgini.com; endpoint/UPGINI_URL may override it.
execution_trace.isolated_trace: An AST-extracted collector ran with mocked OS, network and identity dependencies only. Error responses yield account IDs; even a successful secret response yields no returned secret. Sentinel secret and token values never entered the profile. No package install or live service authentication occurred.
execution_trace.other_execution: exec checks availability of the fixed kaggle import. Hash utilities use subprocess argument lists without a shell. Base64 status content from GitHub is decoded and printed; report downloads use Base64 data URLs.
execution_trace.remote_code: Fetched a.js is FingerprintJS v3.4.2; its executable body is byte-identical to the official CDN build, differing only by a header blank line. Browser probes feed a MurmurHash visitor ID. Minification is library code, not an injected loader.
